predictions.articleTitle: Bayern München vs Arsenal Prediction & Match Analysis: Key Absences Shift Expected Goals — Scoreline Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: Bayern München's unmatched European home pedigree and Harry Kane's finishing are counterbalanced by the absence of Olise and Musiala, pointing toward a tight contest captured by Home Win / Draw and Under 2.5.

Bayern edge a narrow 2:1 victory driven by Harry Kane's clinical execution against a Saliba-less Arsenal backline (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
